issue.title: Implement Reconnect Claim Sync and Conflict Detection
issue.body:
When a device comes back online, any claims made during the offline window need to be pushed to the server and validated. This ticket implements the reconnect sync path for claims: push pending offline claims, confirm clean claims silently, detect multi-claimant conflicts, surface the conflict state on the chapter row, and clear it when a PM resolves the conflict on web.

## Functional Requirements

### Claim Sync on Reconnect

- On reconnect, sync all locally-held offline claims to the server as part of the standard sync cycle.
- If no conflict is detected for a claimed chapter (no other translator claimed or was assigned the same chapter while offline), confirm the claim silently with no visual change to the chapter row.
- If the PM resolved an assignment conflict server-side before reconnect, sync the clean single-assignment state with no conflict surfaced; no special case is needed.

### Conflict Detection and State

- If a conflict is detected on reconnect (another translator created a recording on the same chapter during the offline window), update the chapter row to the conflict state (`li:users` with `li:triangle-alert` badge, per #260).
- Do not silently resolve or auto-assign to either translator; surface the conflict and wait for PM resolution.
- The conflict indicator persists on subsequent syncs until explicitly resolved; it does not auto-dismiss.
- The conflict state is visible to all users with access to the chapter, including both involved translators and the PM.

### Conflict Resolution Receipt

- On each sync cycle, check whether any locally-held conflict chapters have been resolved server-side (PM selected a winning take on web).
- If a previously conflicted chapter now has a single assigned claimant, clear the conflict indicator and update the chapter row to either the "mine" state (`li:user`, primary color `#0b50d0`) or the "taken" state (`li:user`, neutral/muted), depending on which translator the PM assigned.
- Clear the conflict state silently; no prompt or notification is shown to the translator.

Note: This ticket depends on the conflict detection infrastructure in #256 (version tokens and server-side take flagging). PM conflict resolution mechanics are out of scope and will be specified in a separate requirements doc.

comments.body:
### Eng note (updated)

Server work lives in **eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api#272** (claim sync + multi-claimant conflict). Don’t build a fake claim-conflict protocol only on mobile by default.

**Preferred:** ship reconnect sync with `fluent-api#272` (+ #268/#270) as one feature.

**Fallback:** mock the reconnect/conflict UI if API is too heavy, and leave `fluent-api#272` as the explicit follow-up in the PR.

(Audio take conflicts are a different API ticket: eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api#271 / mobile #256.)

Finding from the returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, epic #526), Gap 9. **Severity:** High · **Launch blocker:** To be decided with product. Cross-reference: offline chapter assignment audit #533.

**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `09ff2fd` (PR #559 head), `https://dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenario G.23; 2026-09-28 device log).

**What happened:** a take recorded offline in an unassigned chapter queued an offline claim (`Enqueued offline chapter claim`, assignment 41863). On reconnect the upload started before the claim was pushed, and the server answered HTTP 404 "Verse audio recording not found" (`retryable: false`). The take was marked failed, and the Sync page kept showing failed uploads until the takes were deleted or the user signed out and in.

**Code cause:** uploads start on the reconnect edge, but offline claims are pushed only by the full metadata sync (`syncPendingChapterClaimsForUser`, `src/services/sync.ts:301-341`, called only from `:900` and `:1025`: Sync Now, sign-in, re-auth and the Home "needs download sync" repair). Reconnecting alone does not push claims.

**Suggested extra AC:**

- [ ] On reconnect, pending offline claims sync before audio uploads for those chapters.
- [ ] A take whose upload fails because its claim has not synced stays pending (not failed) and uploads after the claim syncs.
- [ ] Unit test for the claim-before-audio order; Android device QA (offline claim by recording → reconnect → take uploads).

Assessment: `docs/assessments/returning-online-and-sync/README.md` (PR #598)

The offline chapter assignment audit (#533) covered this issue's behavior on device (`main` @ `fb634e5`, Android 10, `dev.api.fluent.bible`).

- **Pass:** translator-vs-translator race pushed within 5 minutes, no peer checker (D.3–D.7): the claim returns a conflict, the conflict indicator shows on both devices, the Record banner appears, and it persists across syncs.
- **Fail:** a PM assignment (web sets a peer checker) or an offline window longer than 5 minutes: the claim gets 404 on every sync, no conflict is shown, and the take is stranded → #610.
- **Fail:** pending claims are pushed only by the full sync, so the reconnect upload and the list refresh act before them → #611.
- PM conflict resolution was not tested (out of scope here, per this issue).

Assessment: `docs/assessments/offline-chapter-assignment/README.md` (PR #609).
